correctness.rationale: Let Q_a(x)=Tr(a x^2) and B_a(h,y)=Tr(2ahy) on the two-dimensional F_p-space H. Orthogonality after x-y=h gives |S_H(a,b)|^2=p^2 sum_(h in radical B_a) psi(bh), since Q_a(h)=B_a(h,h)/2=0 for odd p. Thus the nonzero magnitude is p^(1+d_a/2) and occurs for q/p^d values of b. For H=<u,v>, a maps to the symmetric matrix whose entries pair a with u^2,uv,v^2; its image has rank dim span{1,r,r^2}, r=v/u. It is 3 except when r belongs to quadratic subfield, equivalently H=u F_(p^2) and m even. The generic symmetric-matrix rank counts 1,p^2-1,p^3-p^2, and exceptional relative-trace pairing counts q/p^2 zero forms and no rank-one forms. Substitution proves every zero count, nonzero amplitude level, zero-fiber multiplicity, and exact exceptional-plane count. Independent F_27 finite-field rank enumeration found d=2,1,0 counts 1,8,18 and Z=168, as theorem. No finite test substitutes for field-linear proof.
